rules: No real personal data, credentials, access tokens, payment details, or live location data.
All records must use stable unique IDs.
Relationships must resolve to existing records.
Scenario status must be NOT_RUN, PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED.
PASS and FAIL require evidence_ref, executed_at, and tested_commit_sha.
Never import this dataset into production systems.
notes: Seed fixtures are illustrative test data, not experimental findings.
